questions.q: Why did Deutsche Bank grow faster than its competitors?
a: It accepted risks and clients that other banks avoided
It charged the highest fees in the German market
It refused to do business outside of Germany
It was owned and protected by the German government
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the bank pushed ahead by taking more risk and working with unwanted clients.

questions.q: What did Henry Villard do with money borrowed for the railroad?
a: He used it to fund an extravagant Manhattan mansion
He repaid every loan ahead of schedule
He gave it to the workers building the line
He invested it in a rival German bank
questions.why: Lesson 1 describes the default and the discovery that the money went to his mansion.

questions.q: What role did Deutsche Bank play under the Nazi regime?
a: It financed the regime and converted gold stolen from Holocaust victims
It quietly moved Jewish families out of Germany
It stopped all lending until the war ended
It funded only civilian infrastructure projects
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the bank was the regime's main financier and handled stolen gold.

questions.q: What happened to Bill Broeksmit as investigations closed in?
a: He was found dead after feeling cornered by regulators
He was promoted to run the bank's American branch
He fled to Germany and was never heard from again
He testified and was given immunity from prosecution
questions.why: Lesson 2 describes his suicide after a tape revealed the bank was dodging billions in taxes.

questions.q: How did Deutsche Bank help Donald Trump financially?
a: It lent him money at very low rates when others would not
It bought his golf courses outright and rented them back
It paid off his campaign debts without expecting repayment
It guaranteed his loans through a German government program
questions.why: Lesson 3 says the bank offered unusually cheap loans and refinancing to Trump and his family.
